description: Deterministically validate a committed artifact — pass ONE of flowPath/flow, taskPath, contractPath, scenarioPath/scenario. Tasks and contracts can be grounded against the UI Map (mapPath; updateMap:true records their coverage). compile:true returns the expanded keyless Flow a Task or contract executes as (Tasks only need a `platform`). Nothing is launched and no model is used.

compile.description: Task/contract: return the compiled deterministic executor form

mapPath.description: Optional repo-relative UI Map for grounding

updateMap.description: Record the validated artifact's coverage in mapPath

name: tapp_validate
title: Check a Flow, Task, contract, or Scenario without launching
